requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement is fully resolvable. The semantic ambiguity regarding the temporal scope of the water level check is resolved using Business Rule BR-01, which defines the decision metric as the absolute minimum reading in the window. This necessitates that the water level remains strictly above 100 meters for the entire 4-second duration. Structured as a single functional requirement.

source_fragments: Shut off the pumps if the water level remains above 100 meters for more than 4 seconds.

fields.condition: water level remains above 100 meters for more than 4 seconds

structured_requirements.final_statement: If the water level remains above 100 meters for more than 4 seconds, the system shall shut off the pumps.
structuring_notes: Resolved ambiguity AMB-01 using Business Rule BR-01. The condition implies continuous compliance (absolute minimum reading > 100m) over the 4-second window.
